description: IPX Yearly Cultural Timeline & Lineage Tree — recurring US consumer/holiday anchors, weather/mood cycles, and Spotify/Billboard priority seeding cities.

spotify_billboard_cities.spotify_edge: Largest US streaming & creator seeding hub; highest TikTok-to-Spotify conversion for Pop, Latin, and Corridos.
Top East Coast Billboard radio/streaming crossover market; fashion, media, and nightlife tastemaker hub.
Primary US viral sound incubator for Hip-Hop/R&B; club & creator audio trends here ripple nationwide within 72h.
Midwest streaming anchor; huge college and summer festival multiplier.
Massive Spotify streaming volume for Regional Mexican, car/trokiando culture, and Southern Hip-Hop.
Top 5 US Spotify listener market for bilingual Latin/Pop and Country crossover.
Gateway for Latin/Spanglish sounds, nightlife edits, and Spring Break viral audio.
Billboard Country & Hot 100 crossover capital; TikTok-to-Spotify Country breaks start here.
Fast-growing Southwest Spotify market with massive ASU college & bilingual Gen-Z audience.
UT college first-movers + SXSW discovery engine.
High-energy nightlife, weekend-trip POVs, and festival audio testing ground.
High-share tech/creator audience with strong West Coast Hip-Hop and alt-pop streaming.
Dense East Coast college & R&B/Hip-Hop streaming corridor.
Passionate sports-edit and East Coast college streaming market.
Mardi Gras & festival capital with high viral dance/party audio velocity.
Cozy/rainy-weather mood bellwether; strong gaming & creator-edit streaming.

seasonal_moods.label: Winter Reset & Yearning
seasonal_moods.weather_vibe: Cold indoors, dark evenings, gym resolutions, cuffing peak & breakup season
seasonal_moods.collective_mood: Self-improvement hustle, moody late-night drives, situationship angst, escapism

seasonal_moods.label: Spring Fever & College First-Movers
seasonal_moods.weather_vibe: Warming up, daylight savings, patios, Spring Break travel & festival prep
seasonal_moods.collective_mood: High-energy social revival, outside-again POVs, festival outfits, college chaos

seasonal_moods.label: Peak Summer & Song of the Summer
seasonal_moods.weather_vibe: Heatwaves, beaches, pools, night drives, road trips, golden hour
seasonal_moods.collective_mood: Main-character energy, carefree nightlife, high-tempo anthems, vacation FOMO

seasonal_moods.label: Fall Reset & 'Ber' Months
seasonal_moods.weather_vibe: Crisp air, football weather, hoodies, spooky season, earlier sunsets
seasonal_moods.collective_mood: Nostalgia, back-to-school identity, NFL/tailgate hype, sad-girl/boy autumn, cuffing

seasonal_moods.label: Holiday Peak & Year-End Nostalgia
seasonal_moods.weather_vibe: Cold winter, holiday lights, homecoming travel, year-end reflection
seasonal_moods.collective_mood: Spotify Wrapped flex, Mariah thaw, family memes, nostalgia recaps, NYE party countdown

anchors.name: New Year's & Jan Gym/Reset Wave
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Gym / Self-Improvement Creators & College Winter Break
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Billboard Hot 100 clears out Christmas songs in Week 1 of Jan — massive open chart lane for high-energy workout & fresh-start tracks.

anchors.name: Grammy Awards & Music Industry Peak
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Music Twitter/X, Pop Crave/Base, Stan Accounts & LA Industry
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Peak Spotify catalog surge + Billboard Hot 100/200 bumps for nominated artists and reaction-edit sounds.

anchors.name: Super Bowl Sunday & Halftime Show
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Sports Clips, Watch-Party Memes & Halftime Speculators
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Halftime headliner + commercial sync tracks spike 200-500% on Spotify within 24h; huge sports-edit audio spillover.

anchors.name: Valentine's Day / Galentine's / Situationships
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Relationship POV, Toxic-Ex/Desamor & Galentine's Creators
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Two huge Spotify lanes: romantic couple edits AND bitter/heartbreak 'desamor' counter-programming that dominates TikTok shares.

anchors.name: Mardi Gras & Gulf Coast Carnival
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Southern College, Parade/Party Clips & Bounce/Hip-Hop Creators
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: High-tempo party/dance tracks gain rapid regional Spotify velocity across the South.

anchors.name: RodeoHouston — Texas Country & Regional Mexican Peak
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Texas Car/Truck/Trokiando, Country & Regional Mexican Accounts
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Massive 2.5M+ attendance concert series; drives huge Texas Spotify streaming spikes for Country and Corridos/Regional Mexican.

anchors.name: Spring Break — College First-Mover Wave
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Chronically Online College Students (SEC, Big 10, TX, FL, AZ)
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: College kids are the #1 early adopters of new sounds — a track that wins Spring Break boat/beach/party playlists becomes a May Billboard climber.

anchors.name: SXSW — Austin Music & Creator Discovery
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Music Discovery Blogs, Indie/Hip-Hop/Latin Showcases & Creators
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Early buzz incubator for breakout artists and viral live-clip seeding.

anchors.name: March Madness & Bracket Chaos
anchors.first_mover_cohort: College Sports Edit Pages, Gambling/Bracket Memes & Barstool/Overtime
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Buzzer-beater highlight edits + underdog hype tracks drive massive short-form replay loops.

anchors.name: Miami Music Week & Ultra
anchors.first_mover_cohort: DJ/Club Remixers, Latin Nightlife & Electronic Creators
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Remix & sped-up/club flips premiered here dominate Spotify Dance/Latin playlists through summer.

anchors.name: Coachella & Festival Season Kickoff
anchors.first_mover_cohort: LA Influencers, Fashion/GRWM, Pop Stan Accounts & Live-Stream Clippers
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Coachella live-stream clips trigger instant Spotify Daily Top 50 surges; huge Latin & Pop crossover stage.

anchors.name: Kentucky Derby & Southern Spring Weekend
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Nashville/Southern Lifestyle, Country & Luxury Watch-Party Creators
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Prime Country & Pop-Country lifestyle seeding moment across the South and Midwest.

anchors.name: Met Gala — High-Fashion Meme & Pop Culture Spike
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Pop Crave/Base, Fashion Roast Pages & Celebrity Edit Accounts
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: 24-48h viral celebrity edit tsunami — high-glam, dramatic, or roastable tracks get massive 'Use This Sound' lift.

anchors.name: EDC Las Vegas — Nightlife & Festival Anthem Peak
anchors.first_mover_cohort: West Coast Festival, Nightlife & High-Energy Edit Creators
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Tests high-BPM drops and club remixes ahead of Memorial Day.

anchors.name: End of School Year, Prom & Graduation
anchors.first_mover_cohort: High School Seniors & College Grads (High-Share Nostalgia Edits)
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: One of the highest 'Save' and 'Use This Sound' nostalgia spikes of the year for bittersweet/triumphant tracks.

anchors.name: Memorial Day & 'Song of the Summer' Race Launch
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Billboard Chart Watchers, Pool/Boat/Car-Edit & Summer POV Creators
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Billboard officially starts tracking its 'Songs of the Summer' chart on Memorial Day weekend — seed priority summer singles 4-5 weeks prior.

anchors.name: 4th of July — Mid-Summer Peak
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Lake/Beach/Backyard Party, Country-Pop & Summer Nightlife Creators
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Peak Spotify summer playlist listening weekend; highest outdoor party & road-trip audio consumption.

anchors.name: San Diego Comic-Con & Anime/Fandom Peak
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Anime, Marvel/DC, Gaming & Faceless AMV/Clip Edit Pages
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Massive trailer/announcement cycle — prime window for faceless anime/superhero beat-sync edits with high-energy client tracks.

anchors.name: Lollapalooza — Chicago & Midwest Festival Peak
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Midwest Gen-Z, Pop/Hip-Hop/K-Pop/Latin Live-Clip Accounts
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Huge Midwest Spotify surge for live-streamed sets and late-summer breakout singles.

anchors.name: Back to School, College Move-In & RushTok
anchors.first_mover_cohort: College Freshmen, RushTok/Sorority GRWM & Campus Comedy Pages
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Second biggest college first-mover wave of the year — RushTok & move-in GRWMs regularly launch sleeper tracks onto Spotify Viral 50.

anchors.name: Labor Day, End of Summer & NFL Kickoff
anchors.first_mover_cohort: NFL/Sports Edit Pages, Tailgate Creators & End-of-Summer Nostalgia
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Billboard wraps 'Song of the Summer' and shifts into Fall/NFL hype edits — massive demand for tunnel-walk, highlight, and tailgate anthems.

anchors.name: Fall Reset — 'Ber' Months & Cuffing Season
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Moody/Aesthetic Edit Pages, Late-Night Drive & Relationship POV Creators
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Weather cools and collective mood pivots to yearning, R&B, acoustic/sad-corrido, and moody night-drive playlists on Spotify.

anchors.name: Halloween — Costumes, Spooky Audio & Party Peak
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Costume Reveal, Pop-Culture Meme & College Halloweekend Creators
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Halloweekend drives huge spikes in dark-pop, villain-era, and party-reveal sounds — start seeding Oct 1.

anchors.name: NYC Marathon & Run-Club Grit Wave
anchors.first_mover_cohort: NYC Run Clubs, Fitness/Grit Creators & City Lifestyle Accounts
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Massive NYC-specific cultural moment (50k+ runners, millions of spectators) — high-BPM motivational/grit tracks get huge NYC Spotify & Reels traction.

anchors.name: Thanksgiving, Blackout Wednesday & Black Friday
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Hometown Reunion Memes, Family Roast POVs & College Travel Creators
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Blackout Wednesday (night before Thanksgiving) is the biggest bar/reunion night of the year + massive road-trip Spotify streaming.

anchors.name: Spotify Wrapped & Year-End Chart Recaps
anchors.first_mover_cohort: All Music Fans, Artist Stan Pages & Comedy/Roast Accounts
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Single highest music-sharing week on earth — prime moment for artist catalog flex, 'my top song' meme templates, and rediscovery pushes.

anchors.name: Art Basel Miami — Luxury, Fashion & Nightlife
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Miami Nightlife, Luxury/Car/Fashion & Latin/Hip-Hop VIP Clips
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: High-status flex & club tracks seeded in Miami VIP/nightlife clips spill over into Winter club playlists.

anchors.name: Christmas / Holiday Thaw & Winter Nostalgia
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Cozy Nostalgia, Gift/Family Comedy & Winter-Break Gen-Z Creators
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Holiday classics dominate Billboard Hot 100, so non-holiday music wins via family/homecoming comedy POVs and cozy winter edits.

anchors.name: New Year's Eve Countdown & Year-in-Review Edits
anchors.first_mover_cohort: CapCut Year-in-Review Templates, Nightlife & Party Countdown Creators
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Massive CapCut '2026 in 10 seconds' template wave — landing a client's hook on a recap template drives millions of Jan 1 Spotify streams.

anchors.name: CFP National Championship & College Football Finale
anchors.first_mover_cohort: College Football Edit Pages, SEC/Big Ten/Big 12/ACC Campus Accounts & Sports Clippers
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Peak college-sports hype edit night — tunnel walks, highlight cuts, and championship celebration edits drive huge Spotify Hip-Hop/Rock/Corrido spikes.

anchors.name: NFL Playoffs & Conference Championships
anchors.first_mover_cohort: NFL Highlight Clippers, Barstool/Overtime & City-Specific Fanbase Accounts
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Highest weekly US TV + TikTok highlight volume of winter — target winning-team cities on Spotify right after Wild Card & Divisional rounds.

anchors.name: NBA All-Star Weekend — Hoops, Fashion & Culture Crossover
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Basketball Edit Accounts, Sneaker/Tunnel-Fit Creators & Hip-Hop/Pop Culture Pages
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: NBA players and courtside creators are top Hip-Hop/R&B/Latin tastemakers; tunnel-fit & dunk edits trigger immediate Shazam/Spotify spikes.

anchors.name: NCAA Champ Week — Power 4 & Big East Conference Tournaments
anchors.first_mover_cohort: College Hoops Clippers, Campus Meme Accounts & Selection Sunday Bracket Creators
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Conference tourneys in NYC (MSG), Nashville, Vegas, and Chicago create a 7-day college buzzer-beater edit frenzy right before March Madness.

anchors.name: MLB Opening Day — Spring Sports & City Pride
anchors.first_mover_cohort: City Sports Pages, Walk-Up Song Creators & Day-Drinking/Tailgate POVs
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Walk-up song reveals (especially LA Dodgers, Yankees, Astros, Rangers) spark city-level Spotify spikes for Latin, Hip-Hop, and Country tracks.

anchors.name: NCAA Men's & Women's Final Four
anchors.first_mover_cohort: College Basketball Clippers, Women's Hoops Stars & Mainstream Sports Accounts
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Women's & Men's Final Four now draw Super-Bowl-adjacent social chatter — huge moment for victory/anthem edits.

anchors.name: NBA & NHL Playoffs Tip-Off
anchors.first_mover_cohort: NBA/NHL Highlight Edit Accounts, Arena Hype Pages & Sports Twitter/X
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: 2 months of nightly high-stakes highlight edits — locking a track into NBA playoff TikTok edits sustains Billboard streaming for weeks.

anchors.name: NFL Draft Weekend — College-to-Pro Hype Cycle
anchors.first_mover_cohort: NFL/College Draft Clippers, Green-Room Fit Accounts & Fanbase Reaction Pages
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Walk-out songs, draft-day glow-up edits, and city-welcome reels fuel massive short-form replay loops.

anchors.name: Cinco de Mayo Fight Weekend & F1 Miami GP
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Boxing/UFC Clippers, Las Vegas & Miami Nightlife, Regional Mexican & Latin Edit Pages
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: HUGE bilingual & Latin music weekend — major Mexican boxing PPV walkouts in Vegas + F1 Miami VIP clips drive massive Spotify Latin/Corrido spikes.

anchors.name: NBA Finals & Stanley Cup Finals
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Championship Edit Pages, Parade/Nightlife Clips & Sports Memes
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Peak early-summer sports anthem window — locker room & parade celebration clips catapult tracks into summer playlists.

anchors.name: College Football Kickoff — Power 4 Week 1 & Tailgates
anchors.first_mover_cohort: SEC/Big Ten/Big 12/ACC Student Sections, Tailgate & Stadium-Entrance Accounts
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: College student sections (100k+ stadiums) + tailgate playlists are a massive Spotify & TikTok viral sound launchpad.

anchors.name: Mexican Independence Fight Weekend (Las Vegas PPV)
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Boxing/UFC Clippers, Vegas/LA/TX Corridos & Bilingual Party Accounts
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Peak September Spotify surge for Regional Mexican / Corridos & high-status fight-walkout anthems across Vegas, CA, and TX.

anchors.name: MLB World Series — Fall Classic
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Major-Market Baseball Fanbases, Walk-Off Highlight Clippers & City Pride Pages
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Oct walk-off homers & city championship runs generate huge regional Spotify streaming surges in winning metro markets.

anchors.name: F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix — Nightlife & Luxury Speed
anchors.first_mover_cohort: Car/Motorsport Edit Pages, Vegas Nightlife & Celebrity Paddock Clippers
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Prime faceless car-edit & night-drive audio wave — high-tempo luxury/electronic/corrido edits explode on Reels and TikTok.

anchors.name: College Football Rivalry Week & Power 4 Conference Championships
anchors.first_mover_cohort: SEC, Big Ten, Big 12, ACC & Pac-12/G5 Campus Fanbases & Sports Clippers
anchors.spotify_billboard_angle: Back-to-back weekends of maximum college emotion (Rivalry Week -> Conf Champ Saturday in Atlanta, Dallas, Indy, Vegas) before CFP bracket reveal.
